trap-negation-contrast.evidence: Read in full (65 lines, proof of prop:h3-markov-wenzl-weights). VERIFIED (not traps) — every algebraic step recomputes: [2]_q^3 - 2[2]_q = q^3+q+q^{-1}+q^{-3} = [4]_q exactly; h^2+4 = [2]_q^2 exactly (both 4.043706209 at the proton pin); tr_M = 1 + y_(2,1)(chi^(2,1) - 2) follows from Steps 1-2; and comparing with (4+h^2-3h^4-h^6)/(h^2+4) = 1 - (3h^4+h^6)/(h^2+4) gives y_(2,1) = 1/[2]_q^2, whence y_(3) = ([2]^2-2)/[2]^2 = [4]/[2]^3. The h != 0 side condition is correctly stated. Convention D's z = q^3/(q^2+1) is named; convention C appears only as the named alternative the block declines to rest on.
